# LinkedIn AI Content Generator

> Generate polished, ready-to-publish LinkedIn posts in seconds with AI. Pick a topic, target audience, tone of voice, and post type, then get a complete draft with hashtags, a call-to-action, and an image prompt.

## Pages

- [/](/): Generate a new LinkedIn post — enter your topic, audience, tone, and post type, then submit to create a draft.
- [/history](/history): Browse all previously generated LinkedIn posts linked to your email address.

## Features

- AI-powered LinkedIn post generation
- Customizable topic, audience, tone, and post type
- Automatic hashtag and CTA suggestions
- AI image prompt generation for post visuals
- Post history and status tracking
